title: A cost-sensitive uncertainty triage for SOC workload management for ransomware detection
summary: A ransomware-detection research notebook (CS-UT) that reframes malware triage as a budget-constrained decision problem, using entropy/MC-dropout uncertainty and cost-sensitive routing to send the most uncertain alerts to human analysts. To address class imbalance in the ransomware training data, it uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via SingleTableMetadata) alongside SMOTE to synthesize minority-class samples for training.
